import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem bounded_odd_power_residue_class (B : ℕ) : ∀ n < B, ∀ r : ℕ, r < 3 → (2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 = r ↔ r = 2) := by
  intro n hn r hr
  have h₁ : 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 = 2 := by
    
    have h₂ : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 = 2 := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => norm_num
      | succ n ih =>
        simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.add_mod] at ih ⊢
        <;> omega
    exact h₂ n
  constructor
  · 
    intro h
    have h₃ : r = 2 := by
      omega
    exact h₃
  · 
    intro h
    rw [h]
    <;> simp_all
    <;> omega

theorem bounded_odd_power_residue_class (B : ℕ) : ∀ n < B, ∀ r : ℕ, r < 3 → (2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 = r ↔ r = 2) := by

        <;> norm_num at *
        <;> omega
    have h₃ : 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 = 2 := h₂ n
    exact h₃
  have h₂ : r < 3 := hr
  have h₃ : 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 = r ↔ r = 2 := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h₄ : r = 2 := by
        have h₅ : 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 = r := h

        omega

      have h₆ : 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 = r := by
        rw [h₄]

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem bounded_odd_power_residue_class (B : ℕ) : ∀ n < B, ∀ r : ℕ, r < 3 → (2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 = r ↔ r = 2) := by
  have h_main : ∀ n < B, ∀ r : ℕ, r < 3 → (2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 = r ↔ r = 2) := by
    intro n hn r hr
    have h₁ : r < 3 := hr
    have h₂ : r = 0 ∨ r = 1 ∨ r = 2 := by omega
    rcases h₂ with (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · 
      have h₃ : 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 ≠ 0 := by
        have h₄ : 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 = 2 := by
          
          have h₅ : ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ^ (2 * k + 1) % 3 = 2 := by
            intro k
            induction k with
            | zero => norm_num
            | succ k ih =>
              simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, ih]
              <;> omega
          exact h₅ n
        omega
      simp_all
    · 
      have h₃ : 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 ≠ 1 := by
        have h₄ : 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 = 2 := by
          
          have h₅ : ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ^ (2 * k + 1) % 3 = 2 := by
            intro k
            induction k with
            | zero => norm_num
            | succ k ih =>
              simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, ih]
              <;> omega
          exact h₅ n
        omega
      simp_all
    · 
      have h₃ : 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 = 2 := by
        
        have h₄ : ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ^ (2 * k + 1) % 3 = 2 := by
          intro k
          induction k with
          | zero => norm_num
          | succ k ih =>
            simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, ih]
            <;> omega
        exact h₄ n
      simp_all
  exact h_main

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem bounded_odd_power_residue_class (B : ℕ) : ∀ n < B, ∀ r : ℕ, r < 3 → (2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 = r ↔ r = 2) := by
  intro n hn r hr
  have hpow : ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ^ (2 * m + 1) % 3 = 2 := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        norm_num
    | succ m ih =>
        rw [show 2 * Nat.succ m + 1 = (2 * m + 1) + 2 by omega, pow_add]
        rw [Nat.mul_mod, ih]
        norm_num
  rw [hpow n]
  omega
